corrections.original_value: A cartoon man with short black hair under a white headband printed with a red circle and two black kanji looks out with red-rimmed, bloodshot eyes, dark under-eye bags and raised, drawn-together brows. His mouth hangs open showing teeth; he has a moustache and goatee. His bare chest and shoulders carry multicoloured tattoos, including a red horned mask, a gold-and-orange fish and blue-teal wave patterns. A thin black curved arrow runs from the text to his head on a plain white ground.
